about_the_game:
The NIMRODS Supporter Pack is a way for players who love the game to show extra support for our small Indie team. This pack does not add new gameplay features or power. Instead, it grants you a set of exclusive cosmetic touches with a golden flair.

By purchasing this pack, you'll unlock:
  • Golden Supporter Badge - displayed next to the logo on the main menu.
  • Golden Target Dummies - train in style at the Home Ship Target Range.
  • Golden Roobie - your trusty vacuum companion, now shining with a golden upgrade.
  • Golden Drone - gleaming in the Home Ship and during your runs.

⚠️ Please note: The Supporter Pack contains cosmetic items only and does not provide any in-game advantage. Purchasing this pack is simply a way to support development and help us continue making NIMRODS bigger and better.

Thank you for supporting us ❤️

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon or Intel x64
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon or Intel x64
  • Memory: 1500 MB RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Capable of DX11 or higher
  • Storage: 600 MB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
